The Open Hour. Tonight, at 3:30 a.m. German time.

In the night of the full moon, an hour opens for every human being who has quietly asked for it within beforehand. No gift is needed, and you need not be awake; the hour finds you, wherever you are.

One hour, from 3:30 to 4:30 a.m. CET. Free, without registration, for every human being. All open hours as a calendar: link in profile.

Music: "Peace" from The Weight of Knowing, composed by Bastian Aue.

#fullmoon #fullmoonnight #stillness #meditation #innerpeace
